G3937.name: Parmenas
G3937.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3937.short: Parmenas was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to serve as deacons in the early church.

G3934.name: Parthians
G3934.short: Parthians, one of the people groups present in Jerusalem at Pentecost.

G3969.name: Patrobas
G3969.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3969.brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
G3969.short: Patrobas, a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

G3972G.name: Paul
G3972G.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G3972G.brief: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles
G3972G.short: Paul, also known as Saul, the apostle to the Gentiles and author of many New Testament epistles.

G3974.name: Paphos
G3974.brief: A city on the island of Cyprus
G3974.short: Paphos was a city on the island of Cyprus, where Paul and Barnabas encountered a sorcerer and converted the proconsul to Christianity.

G3959.name: Patara
G3959.brief: A city in Lycia visited by Paul
G3959.short: Patara was a coastal city in Lycia (modern-day Turkey) where Paul changed ships during his journey to Jerusalem.

G3963.name: Patmos
G3963.brief: An island where John received the Revelation
G3963.short: Patmos is a Greek island in the Aegean Sea where the apostle John was exiled and received the visions recorded in the Book of Revelation.

G3904.name: Preparation Festival
G3904.brief: The day before the Sabbath or Passover
G3904.short: The day of Preparation was the day before the Sabbath (<ref="Mrk.15.42; Luke 23:54">Mrk.15.42; Luke 23:54</ref>) or the day before the Passover (<ref="Jhn.19.14, 31, 42">Jhn.19.14, 31, 42</ref>).
